fn isLiteralOperandKind k: String -> Bool
  (or (= k "number")
  (or (= k "bigint")
  (or (= k "string")
  (or (= k "boolean")
  (or (= k "null")
      (= k "regex"))))))

fn isBinaryOpKind k: String -> Bool
  (or (= k "star")
  (or (= k "slash")
  (or (= k "percent")
  (or (= k "starStar")
  (or (= k "eqEq")
  (or (= k "bangEq")
  (or (= k "eqEqEq")
  (or (= k "bangEqEq")
  (or (= k "lt")
  (or (= k "lte")
  (or (= k "gt")
  (or (= k "gte")
  (or (= k "shl")
  (or (= k "shr")
  (or (= k "shru")
  (or (= k "amp")
  (or (= k "caret")
  (or (= k "pipe")
  (or (= k "ampAmp")
  (or (= k "pipePipe")
      (= k "questionQuestion")))))))))))))))))))))))

fn isPrefixKeywordKind sl: String -> Bool
  (or (= sl "typeof")
  (or (= sl "void")
  (or (= sl "delete")
  (or (= sl "await")
      (= sl "new")))))

fn isBinaryKeywordKind sl: String -> Bool
  (or (= sl "in")
      (= sl "instanceof"))

fn nextNonTriviaToken toks: (List tr/Token) -> tr/Token
  (if (listEmpty? toks)
    (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)
    (let [(hd (optionOr (listHead toks) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)))
          (tl (optionOr (listTail toks) (list)))]
      (if (isTriviaTok hd)
        (nextNonTriviaToken tl)
        hd))))

fn validateTokensLoop toks: (List tr/Token) text: String stack: (List (Pair String Int64)) questions: (List Int64) pendingTemplate: Int64 expectOperand: Bool lastOpOff: Int64 lastOperandStart: Int64 prevKind: String -> (Option Int64)
  (if (listEmpty? toks)
    (if (not (listEmpty? stack))
      (some (pairSecond (optionOr (listHead stack) (pair "" 0))))
      (if (not (listEmpty? questions))
        (some (optionOr (listHead questions) 0))
        (if (>= pendingTemplate 0)
          (some pendingTemplate)
          (if expectOperand
            (some lastOpOff)
            (none)))))
    (let [(hd (optionOr (listHead toks) (tr/makeToken "" 0 0)))
          (tl (optionOr (listTail toks) (list)))
          (k (tr/tokenKind hd))]
      (if (isTriviaTok hd)
        (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate expectOperand lastOpOff lastOperandStart prevKind)
        (let [(off (tr/tokenStart hd))]
          (cond
            ((or (= k "lparen") (or (= k "lbracket") (= k "lbrace")))
             (validateTokensLoop tl text (cons (pair k off) stack) questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((or (= k "rparen") (or (= k "rbracket") (= k "rbrace")))
             (if (listEmpty? stack)
               (some off)
               (let [(top (optionOr (listHead stack) (pair "" 0)))]
                 (if (or (and (= k "rparen") (= (pairFirst top) "lparen"))
                         (or (and (= k "rbracket") (= (pairFirst top) "lbracket"))
                             (and (= k "rbrace") (= (pairFirst top) "lbrace"))))
                   (validateTokensLoop tl text (optionOr (listTail stack) (list)) questions pendingTemplate false lastOpOff lastOperandStart k)
                   (some off)))))
            ((= k "question")
             (if expectOperand
               (some off)
               (let [(nTok (nextNonTriviaToken tl))
                     (nOff (tr/tokenStart nTok))]
                 (if (and (= (tr/tokenKind nTok) "number")
                          (and (= nOff (tr/tokenEnd hd))
                               (stringStartsWith? (tokenSlice nTok text) ".")))
                   (some (+ nOff 1))
                   (validateTokensLoop tl text stack (cons off questions) pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k)))))
            ((= k "colon")
             (if expectOperand
               (some off)
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack (optionOr (listTail questions) (list)) pendingTemplate true lastOpOff lastOperandStart k)))
            ((= k "comma")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((= k "dot")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((= k "questionDot")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((or (= k "plusPlus") (= k "minusMinus"))
             (if expectOperand
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k)
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate false lastOpOff lastOperandStart k)))
            ((or (= k "plus") (= k "minus"))
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((or (= k "bang") (= k "tilde"))
             (if expectOperand
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k)
               (some off)))
            ((= k "ellipsis")
             (if expectOperand
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k)
               (some off)))
            ((isBinaryOpKind k)
             (if expectOperand
               (some off)
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k)))
            ((isAssignmentToken k)
             (if expectOperand
               (some off)
               (if (isLiteralOperandKind prevKind)
                 (some lastOperandStart)
                 (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))))
            ((= k "keyword")
             (let [(sl (tokenSlice hd text))]
               (cond
                 ((or (= sl "this") (= sl "super"))
                  (if expectOperand
                    (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate false lastOpOff off sl)
                    (some off)))
                 ((isPrefixKeywordKind sl)
                  (if expectOperand
                    (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart sl)
                    (some off)))
                 ((isBinaryKeywordKind sl)
                  (if expectOperand
                    (some off)
                    (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k)))
                 (else
                  (if expectOperand
                    (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate false lastOpOff off sl)
                    (some off))))))
            ((or (= k "number") (or (= k "bigint") (or (= k "string") (or (= k "boolean") (or (= k "null") (or (= k "regex") (or (= k "ident") (= k "privateIdent"))))))))
             (if expectOperand
               (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate false lastOpOff off k)
               (some off)))
            ((= k "templateNoSub")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate false lastOpOff off k))
            ((= k "templateHead")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate (if (< pendingTemplate 0) off pendingTemplate) true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((= k "templateMiddle")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate true off lastOperandStart k))
            ((= k "templateTail")
             (validateTokensLoop tl text stack questions pendingTemplate (- 0 1) false lastOpOff off k))
            (else
             (some off)))))))

fn findSyntaxError tokens: (List tr/Token) text: String -> (Option Int64)
  (validateTokensLoop tokens text (list) (list) (- 0 1) true 0 0 "")

fn parse text: String -> (Result tr/Node String)
  (let [(tokens (lx/tokenize text))
        (errOff (findSyntaxError tokens text))]
    (mt errOff
      ((some off) (err (str "syntax error at offset " (stringFromInt64 off))))
      ((none)
       (let [(root (parseTokens tokens text))]
         (if (tr/isErrorNode root)
           (err "syntax error at offset 0")
           (ok root))))))
